About Ol Oret Luxury Lodges

Rooted in the land, woven through time

Ol Oret Luxury Lodges are inspired by the timeless cycles of nature, where wildlife, the changing seasons, and life itself continue in an unbroken rhythm. Rooted in the spirit of Tanzania, Ol Oret Luxury Lodges celebrate the enduring beauty of the wilderness and the profound connection between people and nature.

Every stay is thoughtfully designed to immerse guests in authentic safari experiences while offering exceptional comfort, warm hospitality, and refined luxury.

At Ol Oret Luxury Lodges, each journey becomes part of nature's everlasting story — creating unforgettable memories that remain long after the adventure has ended.

Ol Oret Grumeti Luxury Lodge Robanda · Serengeti

Ol Oret Grumeti, named "the never-ending circle," sits in the heart of Robanda on the Serengeti's western corridor. The lodge blends refined luxury with authentic African character, offering spacious tented suites, locally inspired cuisine, personalized service, and carefully curated safari adventures rooted in the surrounding wilderness.

Ol Oret Chemchem Luxury Lodge Lake Manyara – Tarangire

Ol Oret Chemchem stands on Tanzania's great elephant corridor between Lake Manyara and Tarangire, offering guests rare encounters with elephants following ancestral routes for centuries. The lodge combines understated luxury with conservation, featuring elegant accommodations with uninterrupted wilderness views, exceptional hospitality, locally inspired cuisine, and peaceful moments beneath ancient baobabs that invite guests to reconnect with nature at their own pace.

Accommodation

Our lodge features 20 permanent luxury tents, including family tents carefully designed to blend seamlessly with the surrounding landscape. Each tent rests on beautiful stone flooring and is accented with natural stone décor, creating a warm and timeless connection to the environment. Large glass windows invite the outside in, filling each space with natural light and offering uninterrupted views of the Serengeti wilderness.

At Ol Oret Grumeti, luxury is defined not only by comfort but by a genuine connection to nature, community, and the Serengeti landscape. Here, every moment invites you to slow down, breathe deeply, and experience the magic of Africa in its most authentic form.

Accommodation Tents

Elegant tents built on raised stone floors with en-suite facilities and an outside shower. After a day on safari guests can enjoy a refreshing shower under the stars. Each tent has its own private balcony from where to enjoy the landscape and the environment. The family tent consists of two rooms interconnected, each room with ensuite facilities and private porch.

Experiences

Wildlife Safaris and Game Drives

Enjoy the game drives in the Serengeti all year around. The unique positioning of our lodge enables you to explore the central Serengeti game viewing and the great migration.

Night Game Drives

An exclusive after-dark safari revealing the hidden, nocturnal side of the Serengeti — where predators hunt and the wilderness truly comes alive.

Walking Safaris

Guided bush walks (where permitted, often in nearby conservancies), bird watching and photography experiences and exploring the remote western Serengeti ecosystem (Robanda area) known for resident wildlife year-round.

Cultural & Maasai Village Visits

Visits to nearby Maasai communities and learning about local traditions, lifestyle, and conservation.

Bush Breakfast

Enjoy a beautiful breakfast in the bush after an early game drive in the morning.

Sundowner Cocktails and Campfire

Enjoy a glass of wine and cocktails under the skies after an afternoon game drive. One of the safari highlights is sitting around the camp fire, listening to the sounds of the wild, watching the sun go down and watching the never-ending sky.

Hot Air Balloon Safari

A hot air balloon safari over the Serengeti National Park is a breathtaking sunrise experience where guests float silently above the plains, spotting wildlife from a unique aerial view. After landing, the adventure ends with a champagne bush breakfast, served in the wild under acacia trees — combining luxury, exclusivity, and unforgettable scenery in one experience. This experience starts at 4.30am and the safari in the sky is 50 to 90 minutes depending on the weather.

Massage and Spa

After a day on a game drive, pamper yourself with a relaxing and rejuvenating massage. There is a choice of a 1 hour 30 minutes body massage, a head massage, a manicure or pedicure.

Gym & Fitness

Keep up your routine in the wild — a fully equipped gym with modern cardio and strength equipment, open daily for guests before or after time on safari.
